title: Regulamento 17ª edição do MIUT 2026 (official regulations PDF)
publisher: MIUT – Madeira Island Ultra-Trail / Clube de Montanha do Funchal (hosted by ATRP)
claims: The 2026 regulations, for the 17th edition, list MIUT LEGEND 110 km with 7,200 m of positive and negative gain and a 32-hour limit, ADVANCED 80 km with 4,760 m and 25 hours, DISCOVER 56 km with 2,800 m up and 3,060 m down and 15 hours, MARATHON 40 km with 1,450 m up and 2,000 m down and 11 hours, and STARTER 17 km with 510 m up and 520 m down and 3 h 30 min.
The 2026 LEGEND starts at 23:59 on 24 April in Porto Moniz.
The organiser provides GPS tracks for the courses, but the marking on the ground always prevails.
All aid stations have cut-offs, and a runner must leave a checkpoint before it closes or be disqualified.
The courses are mainly paths, trails, veredas, levadas, unpaved forest roads and small asphalt stretches, are not closed to traffic, and may cross public roads and private property.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 从 ATRP 站点下载 2026 届官方规程 PDF（370,648 字节），用 pypdf 提取文本 75,912 字符，读取 2.3 距离表、2.4 赛道性质、2.5 关门、2.7 检查点、2.8 补给、2.9 装备
